verdict.rationale: Canny documents an official JavaScript SDK for identifying users and embedding widgets on web and mobile, and its llms.txt references SDK installation. There is also a REST API reference. The SDK is narrowly scoped to client-side identify and widget embedding, and probes found no OpenAPI spec to generate clients from. Missing for 10: server-side or multi-language official SDKs, SDK coverage of the full API surface, a published OpenAPI spec, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
